BiblicalUsage: Bar means son, and it appears in the mother's cry to her son in Proverbs and in the psalm's command to kiss the Son lest He be angry.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Son in the psalm is the King God has set on Zion, and kissing Him is not flattery but submission to the One whose wrath and whose blessing are both real.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
